findings.correction: Label supplied shadow decision validation; distinguish local approval record from an external executor or enforcement boundary.

findings.correction: Scope to optional connectors not enabled by Factor profile and candidate repositories not installed by this work; other installed tools were not globally audited.

findings.correction: Say native pilot not executed or validated by this work; effective company profile configuration uninspected.

artifacts.readability: All main-body text legible at 1600px render; no main-body clipping observed.

findings.issue: Company described as immutable; Hermes said to have no memory of its own.
findings.correction: Company is mutable/versioned; immutable source revisions are a narrower property. Hermes provides native profile memory; company facts/authority remain company-owned.

findings.issue: Published baseline described as active framework/rooms; runtime negatives are unscoped.
findings.correction: Distinguish released source, 237 local tests, installed Hermes capability, and pending company pilot. Scope non-execution claims to this work.

findings.issue: Fail-open called blocage and said to disable all native protections.
findings.correction: Describe possible bypass of general gates under invalid config/import failure; destructive unattended memory remains subject to its separate staging/denial behavior. Verify both memory and skills effective gates.

findings.issue: Displayed ingest_bookmarks command omits required --cache.
findings.correction: Remove truncated commands or reproduce complete reviewed guide examples verbatim with labelled placeholders.

findings.issue: Displayed content_trial command omits required --root and --card-id.
findings.correction: Remove truncated command or include all required arguments and an indexed page under the isolated company root.

findings.issue: corrections command lacks root, --proposal-id, --approver; [ID] wrongly used as SHA-256.
findings.correction: Use corrections.py ROOT accept-rule --proposal-id ID --approver NAME --expected-sha256 REVIEWED_DIGEST. Prefer guide example, never executable invented arguments.

findings.issue: Staging presented as unconditional; review-to-replay path omits explicit approval and verified approved bytes.
findings.correction: Require enabled verified skills.write_approval; inspect persisted pending diff, approve/reject, verify bytes, then fresh-session held-out replay. Native pilot remains proposed.

findings.issue: Approval validate example misses root/card_id/action/target/approval_id and uses invalid JSON; record described as jetable.
findings.correction: Use complete reviewed example or omit. Validation neither creates a record nor consumes it once; local trusted caller is not authenticated human approval or external execution.

findings.issue: Unscoped assertion that no external orchestration tool is installed.
findings.correction: State no candidate repository was installed by this work; do not infer global installation state.

findings.issue: Completed checkmarks and confirmed CLI gate/profile claims imply runtime acceptance already achieved.
findings.correction: Use empty checklist boxes and label proposed acceptance criteria; effective company profile and native pilot have not been verified by this work.

findings.issue: Founder described as exclusive owner of final truth / unique truth engine.
findings.correction: Founder owns decisions and claim acceptance; review does not make facts true or guarantee semantic entailment.

findings.issue: Avertissement de Blocage (Fail-Open) mistranslates fail-open.
findings.correction: Use risque de contournement de la porte en cas d’erreur.

findings.issue: Metrics combine targets and observed outcomes without a clear proposed label.
findings.correction: Label target metrics for the future pilot, not measured achievements.

findings.correction: Optional polish: use unlabeled decorative drawing.
